action-bar.name: open
action-bar.desc: Whether the action bar is open/visible.

action-bar.name: onOpenChange
action-bar.desc: Event handler called when the open state changes.

action-bar.name: side
action-bar.desc: The side of the viewport to align the action bar.

action-bar.name: sideOffset
action-bar.desc: Distance from the side of the viewport (in pixels).

action-bar.name: align
action-bar.desc: The alignment of the action bar along the viewport side.

action-bar.name: alignOffset
action-bar.desc: Distance from the aligned edge (in pixels). Only applies when `align` is `'start'` or `'end'.`

action-bar-selection.name: child
action-bar-selection.desc: Use render delegation to render your own element. See Bits UI Child Snippet docs for more information.

action-bar-group.name: child
action-bar-group.desc: Use render delegation to render your own element. See Bits UI Child Snippet docs for more information.

action-bar-item.name: onSelect
action-bar-item.desc: Event handler called when the item is selected. When provided, the action bar will automatically close after selection unless `event.preventDefault()` is called.

action-bar-item.name: child
action-bar-item.desc: Use render delegation to render your own element. See Bits UI Child Snippet docs for more information.

action-bar-close.name: child
action-bar-close.desc: Use render delegation to render your own element. See Bits UI Child Snippet docs for more information.

action-bar-separator.name: child
action-bar-separator.desc: Use render delegation to render your own element. See Bits UI Child Snippet docs for more information.
